Fix: drop the `pub use` lines. Methods are still callable via `<SessionStore>::method_name` or `instance.method_name()` regardless of which file the impl block lives in.
Verified all real callers use `.method_name(...)` form via grep across crates/ — zero path-qualified `counterexample_storage::method_name(...)` call sites exist in the workspace.
